g.text: x whiskers: repeat min/max; y whiskers: marginal Wilson intervals on the same 2,437 roots (correlated models).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: NN move quality and search throughput are different workloads. This is not fixed-time accuracy, Elo or a strength frontier.
